development_only.summary: All effectiveness results are development evidence; the 2026 hidden test is not yet available.

adaptive_program_overfit.summary: Repeated program decisions reused the same 322 development queries; nested evaluation does not eliminate adaptive research overfitting.

restricted_not_comparable.summary: Restricted pilots are not numerically comparable with complete 322-query, 150-candidate evaluations.

topic_slices_overlap.summary: Relevant-candidate slices overlap and are relevance-target analysis handles, not official semantic topics.

missing_raw_artifacts.summary: Several response, label-sweep, source-query, and rejected query-cluster raw or per-query artifacts are absent from this checkout.

issue18_not_restorable.summary: The ignored issue-18 construction tree has no durable remote URI and is not restorable from a fresh repository clone.

external_encoder_taxonomy.summary: Systems using pretrained encoders may be external runs under the track taxonomy.

confidence_not_correctness.summary: Response attempt, confidence, profile similarity, and retrieval score do not establish factual correctness.

bootstrap_protocols_differ.summary: Experiment families used different frozen bootstrap implementations; confidence intervals should not be compared digit-for-digit.

aggregate_per_query_missing.summary: The controlling source preserves aggregates but not a complete tracked per-query metric vector or ranking.

qrel_transferred_training.summary: The method uses development qrels from allowed support queries to construct or select the ranking.

dense_helper_contract_repaired.summary: The dense helper now clips nonpositive finite gains consistently; official historical results were unchanged because their grades were already restricted to 0, 1, and 2.

contextual_e5_selection_limit.summary: Contextual E5 was selected for stability; its paired improvement interval against MPNet included zero.

qwen4b_repeatability_failure.summary: Qwen4B had the strongest label-sweep point estimate but failed strict all-150 repeatability on two adjacent tail orders.

restricted_qrel_assisted.summary: The restricted pilot questions and candidate sets were selected with development qrels.

firstmistral_runtime_repeatability.summary: FirstMistral repeated under pinned Transformers but not under vLLM, and remained below restricted contextual E5.

invalid_output_contract.summary: No quality result exists because the tested output failed the required complete machine-valid ranking contract.

six_query_signal_did_not_scale.summary: The six-query feasibility signals did not justify continuation: pointwise weakened on the later 12x20 diagnostic and generic listwise was later unscorable.

response_inventory_dependence.summary: Response-based scores depend on the frozen response inventory and show material association with response volume.

response_normalization_stopped.summary: The normalization branch failed its inventory-bias gates and was stopped despite a higher effectiveness point estimate.

source_query_stopped.summary: The source-query-first branch failed all four declared gates and was stopped.

behavior_not_effectiveness.summary: The behavior/topic profile is a constructed descriptive artifact, not an evaluated router or correctness score.

profile_qrel_seal_deviation.summary: Semantic profile construction was qrel-free, but the tracked receipt records a digest-only procedural seal deviation.

profile_posthoc_diagnostic.summary: The profile-heavy reproduction is explicitly diagnostic-only and cannot be promoted from the tracked reproduction.

issue18_query_sensitivity_stop.summary: Issue 18 reused previously seen development queries, failed query-sensitivity checks, and permits no promotion or independent-validation claim.

hard_cluster_valid_negative.summary: The hard query-cluster aggregation passed integrity checks but failed every effectiveness gate.

hard_cluster_posthoc_preflight.summary: Its matched-support mechanism check was post-hoc development analysis and cannot establish promotable effectiveness.
